organic_results.description: Habit Tracker: A simple daily planner to schedule and track your routine, making it easy to build lasting habits. Join 15M+ happy users, achieve your goals, and make every day count! More than a self-care companion, it lets you share with others to grow and improve together. ----Useful Features---- Sync with Apple Health: Track water intake, steps, sleep, exercise, and calories to seamlessly monitor your wellness journey. Build & Quit Habits: Create positive routines or break free from bad habits with tailored tracking. Flexible Goal Tracking: Measure progress with specific units (e.g., minutes, glasses of water), not just checkmarks. Group Habits: Stay motivated by building, reminding, and tracking habits with friends or loved ones. Insightful Stats: Get detailed analytics to evaluate and celebrate your progress. Habit Reports: Weekly, monthly, and yearly reports to visualize your growth. Mood Tracking: Monitor your mental wellness to stay balanced and mindful. Smart Reminders: Set time- or location-based reminders to stay on track effortlessly. Multiple Reminders: Add as many reminders as needed for any habit. Custom Sounds: Record or import unique reminder sounds for a personal touch. Widgets for Easy Access: Use Home Screen & Lock Screen to log habits instantly without opening the app. HRV Stress Monitor: Track your heart rate variability (HRV) to measure stress levels and gain insights into your well-being Habit Diary: Jot down notes to reflect on your journey in a personal habit memo. Focus Timer: Stay focused with natural sounds & create a calming, distraction-free environment Cloud Sync: Back up and sync your data across devices for seamless access. Daily Inspiration: Enjoy motivational wallpapers and quotes to keep you inspired. Privacy Protection: Secure your data with FaceID or TouchID. Friendly Competition: Compete with friends to see who’s crushing their habits. ADHD Planner: ADHD friendly plans built-in to help. Dark Mode: Sleek design for a comfortable experience, day or night. Habit Tracker helps you simplify your daily routine, clear your mind, stay on track with your goals, and build a better life. Download now! Perfect for ADHD users, this app simplifies planning and tracking to help you stay focused, build routines, and thrive with ease. NOTE: Habit reads data for some habits from Apple Health app (Steps, energy, walking, running ..etc). No data is being sent outside of your device. Health app access required. organic_results.title: Habit Tracker: Habit OK
organic_results.release_note: Fixed bugs and improved app stability
organic_results.description: Habit OK is a simple habit tracker and task manager for daily routines, goals, reminders and progress stats. Build good habits, break bad patterns, plan tasks, and keep your day on track without clutter. Create habits for repeating actions and tasks for one-off work. Organize tasks into sections, add subtasks, comments and flags, review change history, and check things off from a clear daily workspace. Use Habit OK for reading, workouts, water, study sessions, deep work, household tasks, screen-time limits, nicotine, caffeine, sugar, journaling, or any routine you want to repeat. Why Habit OK works: • Fast habit tracking: see today, tap once, move on. • Good and bad habits: build positive routines and limit unwanted patterns. • Full task manager: sections, subtasks, comments, flags and change history. • Streaks and progress: review completion, consistency and long-term changes. • Smart reminders: get nudges on the right days and times. • Home Screen widgets: mark habits faster without opening the app. • Meanings: keep your reasons and motivation close. • Flexible appearance: make the app feel calm and personal. Habit OK brings habits and tasks into one focused workspace. Repeating actions live in the habit tracker; one-off work lives in tasks. That makes it easier to see what matters today, stay consistent, and keep progress visible. Start small. Track today. Add a task. Build a system you can actually keep. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

organic_results.title: Habit Tracker - HabitKit
organic_results.release_note: - Press and hold a habit, then drag to reorder it - Habits with a daily target show it as marks around the ring - Faster launch, and a new look for the view switcher - Quit habits now show your clean days on the calendar - Fixed: reminders after a phone restart, streaks and past days after a goal change, emoji picker crashes, and right-to-left layouts
organic_results.description: HabitKit is the perfect app for anyone looking to form new habits or break old ones. With HabitKit, you can track your progress with beautiful tile-based grid charts. Whether you're trying to quit smoking, eat healthier, or exercise more, HabitKit can help you achieve your goals. You can customize your dashboard by adjusting colors, icons and descriptions. Draw motivation from growing the amount of colored tiles on your habit dashboard. --- CREATE HABITS Add your habits you want to track in a fast and easy way. Provide a name, description, icon and color and you're good to go. DASHBOARD All your habits are displayed on your dashboard represented by a cool looking grid chart. Every filled out square show a day where you kept up with your habit. CALENDAR The calendar provides a fast and easy way to manage past completions. Simply tap a day to remove or add a completion. ARCHIVE Do you need a break from a habit and don't want to clutter your dashboard with it? Just archive it and restore it at a later point from the menu. IMPORT AND EXPORT Switching phones and don't want to lose your data? Export your data to a file, save it wherever you want and restore it at a later point of time. PRIVACY FOCUSED All your data belongs to you and stays on your phone. No sign-in. No servers. No cloud. --- Terms of Use: https://www.habitkit.app/tos/ Privacy Policy: https://www.habitkit.app/privacy/
